contracts.claim: Select only published channel/version releases, accept only recognized GitHub references, normalize v-prefixed numeric versions and select matching platform/checksum metadata.
Update checks observe metadata without package bytes; uncertain ordering, unreachable metadata and missing platform artifacts remain unknown; installed newer versions are never downgraded.

Successful staged files match reported byte count/digest and supplied publisher checksum; absent checksums remain explicitly unverified and declared size differences retain warnings. Checksum rejection preserves prior target. Actual HTTP Content-Length mismatch rejects premature EOF before atomic staging, preserving any prior valid target.
Inspect/history/show/ancestry read actual Git objects and return durable receipt bytes whose digest and HEAD/output lineage match the result.
Every Git action validates local helper/filter/protocol/include restrictions, attributes/object-store/worktree boundaries, consistency snapshots and network denial before issuing a success receipt.
OCR text repair changes only an evidenced repeated renderer prefix, complete HTML table boundary or exact repeated display-math block; nonmatching and unfinished specimens remain byte-identical.
Handoff packets preserve session lineage, objective, prompt stack, completed/remaining plan and next actions, including durable JSON serialization.
Protocol grading compares every expected field to parsed observations and exact correctness requires every field; omitted and altered fields fail.

Unready/security harnesses are ineligible; leaders require complete exact receipt-backed read-only route-intact samples and prefer essential capability coverage while retaining observed execution median.

Static HTML rubric sums only earned points out of 80; combined acceptance requires total at least75 and independently observed browser score at least12. Frozen prompt requires a single offline index.html and 390px.

Every publication audit reads actual workflow files and rejects git push including shell continuation, PR mutation, write APIs, blanket write permission and retired native branch regardless of read-only declared permissions.

Compatibility reports actual local file identity and hashes; hashVerified is true only when installed digest matches nonempty expected digest. Public transport reports credential availability without exposing the key.

A tool with a valid contract becomes execution-ready only with a currently hash/version-verified actual adapter and no execution prerequisites; production readiness additionally requires Boolean validated evidence and no production prerequisites. Discovery preserves agentReady while filtering live execution readiness.

Capability service executes the actual pinned local Git operation, validates output and registers real hash/lineage-bound receipts; bad declared digests or output lineage are rejected before artifact graph mutation.
Folder paths stay under configured roots, ignores cannot include other files, and inbound versioning is required from the supported local set; unsafe choices are rejected before provider requests.

Startup requires the prepared task-local Syncthing v2.1.5 executable SHA-256; missing or mismatched bytes fail closed without downloading. The owned child uses only GUI48473 and TCP48474, with discovery, relays, NAT and upgrades disabled, and is stopped in finally.

Persisted hashed plans configure actual paused folders and ignores only with approval; activation requires separate deletion-propagation approval, supported inbound versioning and actual unpaused readback. Returned receipts match their persisted bytes.
A changed native folder/ignore baseline causes stale_plan before mutation and reports distinct expected and actual baseline hashes.

When native ignores fail after folder creation, restore the previous relationship and independently read back restoration; the native procedure proves absent-folder restoration using a real owned filesystem collision.

Recovery requires approval, the exact folder ID confirmation and the matching native sendonly/receiveonly mode. Persisted requested receipts describe accepted native requests, never completed remote file recovery.

The real capability manifest exposes sync.compatibility through tool.neyvia-folder-sync as sync.health; executing its typed operation reports the actual pinned native executable hash without credential exposure.
